title: Review result
description: What the critic-reviewer returns for ONE concept, with every variant of it in front of it: workspace/concepts/<concept>/review.json. The reviewer fixes what blocks and re-renders; this file records what it found and what it did.

severity.description: 'blocks' only for what makes delivery impossible. Wrong output language, a cut outside its catalog window, a silent ending and an illegible caption all block.

where.description: The exact second or range where it shows.

status.description: 'fixed' means you changed the variant's build.py and re-rendered, never that you patched the MP4. 'not_fixable' needs a reason and a swap that can actually be done.

escalate.description: true when the fix would change the idea of the video: that decision is the chief-editor's, not yours.

quota_check.description: The concept's declared subject_quota, verified against what actually got built. Checked against the concept's own number, never against a fixed one.

cuts_with_subject.description: Counted by hand on the frame strip. Do not trust what the builder reported.

variants_reviewed.description: Every variant of the concept. Reviewing one at a time is what lets an uneven look through.

language_ok.description: Every caption, stamp, hashtag and narration line in the run's output language, correctly spelled. Mixed languages in one video is a blocker.

facts_checked.description: Dates, places and prices that appear on screen, each with what you verified it against. Watch the time zones.

comparison.description: What actually changes between the variants, from comparing the SAME frame across them.

readme.description: The concept's single README.md, in the output language, with every variant inside it. Not one per agent.
